title: Evaluation of periodontal ligament area of maxillary central incisors by a cone-beam computed tomography-periodontal ligament automatic segmentation network during orthodontic treatment
html: The objective of this study was to evaluate the periodontal support tissues of maxillary central incisors before and after orthodontic treatment by measuring the periodontal ligament area (PDLA) using a cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT)-periodontal ligament (PDL) automatic segmentation network.
